name: bs_subagent
stressor: BREADTH synthesis across many files (subagents capability): a plugins/ package of 13 sibling modules each declares CAPABILITY = "<token>"; the task is to (a) collect EVERY module's capability into a single registry.py mapping module-name -> capability, and (b) fix the ONE module whose capability violates the stated naming rule. Answering requires actually reading all 13 scattered files and synthesizing them; delegating the breadth to read-only explorer children (spawn_explore / spawn_agent explorer) is the natural strategy, but the scenario does NOT force delegation -- a single agent that reads everything itself can also pass.
source_note: Purpose-built `plugins` package authored for this benchmark: 13 sibling modules (plug_alpha.py ... and friends) plus __init__.py, NAMING_RULE.md, and a demo.py. Each module body contains exactly one top-level assignment `CAPABILITY = "<token>"`; the tokens are UNGUESSABLE per-module strings (e.g. 'cap_alpha_7f3a9') chosen at authoring time and embedded ONLY in the source, so a correct registry cannot be produced without reading every module. The stated naming rule (NAMING_RULE.md): every CAPABILITY must be lowercase snake_case beginning with the prefix 'cap_'. Exactly ONE module (plug_quartz.py) violates it -- its CAPABILITY is 'Cap-Quartz-D4B2' (wrong case + hyphens + wrong-shaped) -- and its REQUIRED fixed form is the deterministic canonicalization 'cap_quartz_d4b2'. The task: WRITE registry.py at the package root binding module-stem -> capability for ALL 13 modules (using the FIXED value for the violator), and EDIT plug_quartz.py so its CAPABILITY equals the fixed value. No bug crashes anything; the app imports fine. The 'magic' is the conjunction of 13 unguessable tokens + the one canonicalized fix -- obtainable only by reading the whole package.
discriminator: Pure BREADTH: the answer is a SYNTHESIS over 13 files, none individually hard, but no single read suffices. The oracle (outcome-based, unseen-input style) imports the agent's registry.py in a FRESH subprocess and (1) checks it maps EVERY one of the 13 module stems to that module's CURRENT on-disk CAPABILITY value, with NO missing/extra keys, and (2) re-reads plug_quartz.py's source to confirm its CAPABILITY was changed to the canonical 'cap_quartz_d4b2' AND that the registry agrees -- so a partial registry (missed module), a guessed token, or a registry that records the still-violating value all FAIL. A bounded-slice agent fans the read out to explorers (or reads all 13 and keeps them co-resident) and emits a complete, correct registry; a growing-transcript agent that reads files one by one tends to drop or mis-transcribe a token, or to record the violator's old value, which the oracle catches. This tests that the subagents capability WORKS in a real case; it does not force delegation.
